workLog.outcome: Skipping the check in every worktree would drop the issue #682 co-mingling protection wherever worktrees are used. The discriminator is narrower: a log committed in the worktree's own HEAD is imported history, a log written there today is untracked and is a live claim.
_is_linked_worktree compares --absolute-git-dir with --git-common-dir; _is_committed_here probes HEAD:<path>. Both fail closed. The exemption fires only when both hold.

Deleting the exemption turns the worktree test red; making it unconditional turns the live-log test red; forcing the worktree probe to True turns three red including the issue #3343 merged-history test.
